payload.answer: Known issues (Recommended), Band red lines (Recommended), Study from records, Questions on the spot

options.description: feat/known-issues: a recurrence reopens the case. Land first; the band line branch builds on its shared build.py.
options.label: Known issues (Recommended)

options.description: feat/band-red-lines: red band line for an old plugin or an unsettled judge. Lands after known issues.
options.label: Band red lines (Recommended)

options.description: feat/study-from-records: studies traced to records, marked out of date. Based on asked-study, already in main.
options.label: Study from records

options.description: feat/questions-on-the-spot: needs 180 stale links repinned first, and can clash with band red lines on the judge waiting line.
options.label: Questions on the spot

payload.question: Four new branches are handed over and none is approved yet. Which should I land after the current queue? Known issues makes a debug case count as fixed only once proven in the loaded plugin. Band red lines show a red band line for an out-of-date plugin or a judge that cannot settle. Study from records builds studies from the records. Questions on the spot asks the judge's questions all at once in plain words. None has run the full suite, and each is 7 to 13 commits behind main.
